items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Then when -- we had a drummer named Wilbur Kirk, went to Noble Sissle's band, and that's the first time I met Lena Horne. She was a vocalist with Noble Sissle.

ctx.x: -- good. Oh, we had fiddles, we had everything, because we had to play for dancers. We had to play -- it was like a Roxy theater, only we had a big artist -- a star would emcee the show every week, you know, like, let's see. Oh, I mentioned Douglas Fairbanks. Omar Sharif, he would be the emcee. Then Pearl Bailey would be the emcee one week. Lena Horne would be the emcee one week.
And you had to play every kind of music.
